description: A single smooth line with a dot and a printed value at every point.
overview: One natural curve with dots on each month and a `LabelList` above every point, so values are readable without touching the chart. There is no grid; a month axis and a tooltip remain.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your records and change each `dataKey` to match your fields. Change `position` and `offset` on the `LabelList` to move the labels. The component takes no props.
